title: C07 Data fetching & waterfalls

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: Request memoization / dedup is demonstrated with React cache(): the same accessor called multiple times in one request resolves the underlying data once, proven by a logged/asserted single-fetch count.
The solution reproduces a sequential waterfall (intentionally slow) and a fixed parallel version (Promise.all / hoisted promises), with the measured latency difference documented in NOTES.md.
A preload pattern is implemented (kick off the fetch before awaiting / before rendering the consuming component) and explained in spec.md.
cache-flow.md documents the per-request memoization flow distinguishing it from cross-request 'use cache' (forward reference to C08), committed as the cache challenge diagram.

The c07 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; data is read via a local _lib helper over lib/data without editing lib/data.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
